functions.name: solenoid_state_handler
functions.role: Solenoid lock/unlock FSM: samples drive current/voltage/MCU monitors (publishes 6-byte OD frame, raises overcurrent DTCs), then per-state actuates the H-bridge and arms the next settle tick. States: 1=enable_power,2=locking(drive),3=retry_unlock,4=check_locking,5=disable_power.

functions.name: tmag_sensor_handler
functions.role: TMAG5x70 hall-sensor handshake FSM (DEVICE_RESET->STATUS_READ->ID_CHECKED->Z_VAL_READ->THRESHOLD_CONFIGURED). Classifies magnet on Z_VAL_READ (z<0x0e => near/decision 1 else 2), calls apply_lock_decision; on error raises DTC 0xC114 and re-inits the bus up to 3x.

functions.name: tmag_threshold_handler
functions.role: Maps a TMAG threshold event (op 0/1/2) onto the lock-detect class, publishes a 1-byte OD report on change, and on a present magnet may start solenoid_request_unlock; re-posts THRESHOLD_DETECTED (op 5).
